content.text:
Made two small improvements to `0.html`:

- Added `theme-color` meta tags (light/dark) and an empty data-URI favicon to prevent an unnecessary 404 request.
- Replaced the `Math.max(colors.indexOf(...), 0)` trick with an explicit `colors.includes(...)` check — clearer intent and correctly falls back to index `0` for any invalid/corrupted stored value.

The rest of the file was already solid (good a11y, reduced-motion/contrast/forced-colors handling, safe localStorage access), so I kept changes minimal.

Made two small improvements to `0.html`:

- Added `theme-color` meta tags (light/dark) and an empty data-URI favicon to prevent an unnecessary 404 request.
- Replaced the `Math.max(colors.indexOf(...), 0)` trick with an explicit `colors.includes(...)` check — clearer intent and correctly falls back to index `0` for any invalid/corrupted stored value.

The rest of the file was already solid (good a11y, reduced-motion/contrast/forced-colors handling, safe localStorage access), so I kept changes minimal.
